ABOUT ME

Behind the
lens.

I’m Ravindu Adiptha, a Sri Lankan content creator with five years of experience in video editing, graphic design, videography and photography. I’m at home behind the camera and at the editing desk, and I also work as an announcer and sports commentator.

2022Joined the Media Unit at C.W.W. Kannangara Central College and served as a Coordinator.
2023Main Technician for the Media Unit and the school’s Oratory and Debate Society.
2026Media Unit President, leading school event coverage, cricket promos and the Voice of Central podcast.

My favourite part of the work is seeing the footage we captured together turn into a story in the edit. That’s what I enjoy bringing to each project, whether it’s an event film, a promo or a short video for social media.

If you’re looking for someone to film an event, edit footage you’ve already shot or design visuals for your brand, I’d love to hear what you have in mind.
